# `core/compression/LosslessCompression.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/compression/LosslessCompression.js`

LosslessCompression.js - Zero Quality Loss Compression Implements truly lossless compression using: - DEFLATE (zlib): Industry standard, 2-3x compression - LZ77 dictionary compression: Fast, 1.5-2x compression - Huffman coding: Entropy encoding - Combination with existing techniques for maximum compression All compression is 100% lossless - perfect reconstruction guaranteed

## Functions

### `compressLZ77(data)`

Simple LZ77 compression (basis of DEFLATE) Finds repeated sequences and replaces with back-references 100% lossless

### `decompressLZ77(compressed)`

Decompress LZ77 data

### `compressHuffman(data)`

Compress data using Huffman coding 100% lossless entropy encoding

### `decompressHuffman(compressed)`

Decompress Huffman coded data

### `compressLossless(data)`

Compress typed array with zero quality loss Combines LZ77 + Huffman for maximum compression

**Parameters:**

- `data` *(TypedArray)* — Input data

**Returns:** Compressed data (100% lossless)

### `decompressLossless(compressed)`

Decompress losslessly compressed data Perfect reconstruction guaranteed

### `compressFloat32Lossless(floats)`

Compress Float32Array losslessly

### `compressInt16Lossless(ints)`

Compress Int16Array losslessly

### `compressUint8Lossless(bytes)`

Compress Uint8Array losslessly

### `testLosslessCompression()`

Test compression on sample data
